explanation: W = 1.2 GeV is below the eta electroproduction threshold (ep -> e'p eta requires W >= m_p + m_eta = 1.4861 GeV). At this W the eta+proton final state is kinematically inaccessible, so no cross section or radiative correction exists to compute. This is also outside the EXCLURAD lookup table grid (W in [1.4856, 6.0000] GeV), which would force extrapolation of the hadronic model even if the threshold issue were ignored. Refusing to generate an input file for this point; a valid calculation requires W >= ~1.4961 GeV (with some margin above threshold) at Q2 = 1.0 GeV^2.
